## Learning goals

- I can explain how design choices can disable or include people.
- I can write alt text that communicates what an image contributes.

::: {.callout-note}
This lesson reorganizes text from the [Graphics Accommodation Guide](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AfDpLSJQtKy7YUMdwL8-BBR81NTv9Ck_cyzQ4pA2Hk4/edit). Its source links and graphic descriptions are retained below.
:::

{{< include sections/01-access-and-alt-text.md >}}

## Try it

Choose one instructional image. Write one or two sentences explaining the subject, the important relationship, and what the learner needs to notice.
